column1: # Duplicate original MFC-template COMDAT bodies recorded as aliases of one
# canonical body (mfc-collections skill, rule MFC-TWIN-030). VC5 emits one copy
# of an instantiation's out-of-line members per referencing TU; the copies differ
# only by relocations (call targets to twin helper copies, EH refs, data
# addresses). An alias is comparison metadata -- never a reason to invent a
# source class, duplicate an instantiation, or re-model the embedded member.
# Every row is re-verified by `just template-alias-check`:
#   - both addresses are sized functions in config/symbols.csv;
#   - curated names agree (same instantiation, not merely same shape);
#   - normalized instruction structure identical modulo relocations, with
#     paired call targets recursively equivalent (tools.binary.body_hash).
# Discover candidates with `just mfc-collection-audit <Class
# original_address
